Obtain that source folder before using Load unpacked; select the extension folder containing manifest.json rather than the repository root. The already-published v0.4.1 desktop release does not list a separate extension asset. This guide does not imply a browser-store listing or an extension installer bundled into that desktop package. Open the extension source folder Install in a compatible Chromium browser The project documents Chrome/Chromium 102 or newer, or a compatible Chromium-based browser. RepoTunnel must be running locally. Keep the unpacked installation in a stable folder after pairing. Do not delete RepoTunnel application data to change an extension installation. Open the browser’s extensions page, such as chrome://extensions in Chrome/Chromium or edge://extensions in Edge. Enable Developer mode. Choose Load unpacked and select extensions/chatgpt-continuation. Open your exact https://chatgpt.com/c/... conversation. Open RepoTunnel Continuation from the browser toolbar. Choose Add current ChatGPT chat. Chrome: load an unpacked extension Edge: sideload an extension Google’s official example highlights Developer mode and Load unpacked. Select RepoTunnel’s extensions/chatgpt-continuation folder for your installation; the sample extension pictured is Google’s tutorial example. © Google, CC BY 4.0. Save the exact conversations you want You can save up to five exact conversations. A general ChatGPT home URL is not a target, and the companion does not guess another conversation when a saved one is unavailable. Keep the intended saved chat open. Duplicate tabs for the same conversation are refused by the documented continuation flow; close the unnecessary duplicate and inspect status before retrying. Read the extension status Not set: no ChatGPT conversation is saved. Waiting: a saved conversation has not recently registered with the local RepoTunnel bridge. Connected: the saved conversation has recently registered with RepoTunnel. Connected confirms recent registration. It does not mean there is a checkpoint to send or that a delivery has completed. Understand safe delivery The extension waits for an idle completed assistant response and an empty composer. It protects recent human typing, prepares the checkpoint, obtains authorization from RepoTunnel, attempts one send and seeks a positive acknowledgement. If a crash or transport failure makes the post-send outcome uncertain, the message is not automatically replayed. Inspect the actual chat and continuation state before deciding how to recover. Know the data and permissions The extension stores exact saved conversation URLs, tab titles and bounded connection/delivery status in extension-local storage, with temporary bridge-health state in session storage. Its declared hosts are chatgpt.com and the dedicated local bridge at 127.0.0.1:43185. It requests activeTab, alarms, scripting and storage for the saved-chat and heartbeat workflow. The documented companion has no analytics, advertising, telemetry or third-party tracking. Read the extension privacy document Troubleshoot a waiting checkpoint Check that RepoTunnel is running, the intended chat is saved and open at its exact conversation URL, the turn is idle, and the composer is empty. Recent typing, a duplicate tab, an active response or unavailable bridge can keep delivery waiting. RepoTunnel pins the first valid extension origin that registers. Preserve a working paired installation until you intentionally migrate it; replacing folders or clearing app data is not a routine waiting-state fix. Inspect live continuity before continuing Connect ChatGPT Project Memory and live continuity

title: Video Intelligence
description: Analyze supported media with bounded background jobs.
searchText: Video Open Video and choose Analyze Video’s Analyze view is for understanding supported public media or approved local project media. Its displayed modes are Full, Transcript focus, Visual focus and Tutorial focus. Select the intended media/project and mode, add a time range when useful, start analysis and follow the cancellable job’s progress. Fetch or inspect the final content only after the result is available. Analysis modes Transcript Visual Instruction Full Evidence handling RepoTunnel checks existing captions first, extracts bounded smart frames when visuals matter, and prepares compact audio only when captions are unavailable and speech understanding is needed. No execution authority Instructions discovered inside media do not authorize installs, edits, browser actions or other local mutations. Select the analysis mode Transcript mode is appropriate when speech is the primary question. Visual mode focuses on frames and design, instruction mode on tutorial steps, and full mode combines speech and visuals. Analysis uses bounded background jobs and may rely on existing captions, selected frames and compact audio processing when needed. The result should distinguish what was actually observed from inferred interpretation. Use analysis results safely Instructions spoken in a video are not authorization to install software, delete files, change browser state or publish code. Follow-up actions still pass the normal RepoTunnel policies. Media helpers such as yt-dlp and ffmpeg may need provisioning under protected application data when absent; supported provisioners verify trusted downloads rather than silently changing system PATH. yt-dlp documentation FFmpeg documentation Video Production Security model

title: Video Production
description: Maintain durable Video Projects with script, scenes, narration, subtitles, rendering and QA.
searchText: Video Open Video and choose Projects Use Video’s Projects view for production work and keep the intended durable Video Project selected. Analyze is the neighboring evidence-gathering view for existing media. Treat a script, storyboard, scene generation, draft render and QA result as separate pipeline states. Check the project’s current status before repeating a stage after an interruption. Pipeline The canonical production pipeline is Script → Storyboard → Voice → Scenes → Assembly → QA → Export. Project-owned production files Scene-centric records Narration/subtitles Durable render jobs Preview and QA gates Asset/license provenance Resource policy New Video Projects default to no automatic large model/runtime downloads and paid services blocked. Managed model downloads require explicit policy plus per-request opt-in. Create a durable Video Project Video Production maintains project-owned script, storyboard, scene, timeline, narration, assets, previews, render jobs, QA and license records. This allows interrupted production work to resume without confusing an output file with completed QA. The tutorial/explainer path prefers lightweight deterministic HTML/CSS/GSAP scene capture where its dependencies exist, with a native 2D fallback. Story mode has separate director and render routing. Verify before final export Plan the spec, script and storyboard, choose a suitable rendering method and resources, then build the scenes. Generate a low-resolution design preview, inspect representative frames and fix design issues before final rendering. Check the final media with ffprobe and the Video Project QA report. A successful FFmpeg exit is not, by itself, proof that output resolution, timing, audio and subtitles are correct. ffprobe documentation FFmpeg documentation Resource and provenance safety RepoTunnel does not require large local AI models or paid providers as a condition of basic production. Resource policies gate automatic installation/downloads; external assets must keep their license and source records. Video Intelligence Create and restore checkpoints

title: Security model
description: Understand RepoTunnel's layered local security boundaries.
searchText: Security Default position Access is denied unless a project or capability has been explicitly enabled through RepoTunnel's user-controlled surfaces. Core boundaries Approved workspace roots Protected credential paths Fail-closed command sandbox Review/Auto policy separation Validated Git surface Explicit push instruction Loopback raw MCP gateway OAuth for public MCP paths Sensitive browser/desktop semantic fields User-controlled Phone access Do not bypass host policies RepoTunnel is designed to work with operating-system, browser, Android, application and external-service security policies rather than bypass them. Where the trust boundary lives The Rust backend mediates registered workspace IDs, protected filesystem paths, safe editing and command execution. The raw MCP gateway stays bound to loopback and public HTTPS paths are subject to authenticated transport and OAuth rules. AI Auto removes repeated approval prompts only for compatible authorized operations. It is not unrestricted host access or permanent permission to publish Git history. Separate capability grants Desktop, Phone, browser, Git, AI Workspace and terminal operations have different guards. Permission for one does not silently enable another. User-controlled Phone escalation and desktop self-control restrictions cannot be bypassed through a different MCP action. Know the limitations This model applies to RepoTunnel-controlled paths. Applications a person runs manually outside RepoTunnel are not sandboxed by RepoTunnel. macOS uses its current Seatbelt compatibility backend, with a long-term stronger native replacement still a platform consideration. title: Secrets and protected paths
description: Understand the files and outputs RepoTunnel intentionally protects.
searchText: Security Protected files .env and .env.* except example/sample/template variants Common SSH private-key filenames Common credential JSON files .npmrc, .pypirc, .netrc, .git-credentials and credentials.toml .pem, .key, .p12, .pfx, .jks and .keystore Output handling RepoTunnel redacts credential-like terminal/process output and does not intentionally log project source, API keys or raw credentials. Never put credentials in project docs Do not commit OAuth refresh tokens, private keys, ngrok/Cloudflare tokens or tunnel secrets into projects or website source. Provider credentials belong in the supported local configuration paths. Protected-path filters, output redaction, Git secret scanning and restricted child-process environments each provide separate defenses; they do not make it safe to paste credentials into a public issue. Check publish boundaries RepoTunnel validates staged Git content and performs a final secret check before an explicitly authorized push. External Git clean filters and local hooks are restricted along controlled mutation paths. If a suspected secret was ever published, revoke/rotate the credential at the provider. Simply removing a token from the latest commit may not remove it from remote history. Git workflow Workspace access and AI modes

title: Platform status
description: Know which RepoTunnel behaviors are packaged versus natively validated.
searchText: Reference Linux Primary live-validated development platform. Linux supports managed-process reattachment after a full RepoTunnel restart. Windows Packages are produced for x64. Command isolation uses AppContainer + Job Object. Native UI Automation adapters exist and require native compatibility validation for specific runtime claims. macOS Apple Silicon and Intel DMGs are produced. The current command sandbox uses Seatbelt compatibility. Update discovery is supported while in-app update installation remains intentionally disabled pending verified recovery safety. What “supported” means Release packages exist for Linux x64, Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon and Intel. Package compatibility, native automation acceptance and long-running process recovery are separate questions. Linux is the primary verified development target. Windows uses AppContainer + Job Object for sandboxed commands; macOS uses the current Seatbelt compatibility backend. Check feature-specific limits Complete RepoTunnel process restart reattachment for managed jobs is currently Linux-only. Native desktop accessibility behavior requires native testing on Windows/macOS, and macOS in-app update installation is intentionally disabled pending recovery validation. Consult the current release notes and platform documentation before advertising full native feature parity. Install on Linux Install on Windows Install on macOS

title: Connection troubleshooting
description: Diagnose a RepoTunnel connection without weakening the local security boundary.
searchText: Troubleshooting Public connection is not Ready Check Internet connectivity Check provider configuration Restart the configured connection from RepoTunnel Confirm the public health endpoint where applicable Run a real authenticated MCP tool call after transport health is restored ChatGPT asks to reconnect Use ChatGPT's reconnect/reauthorize flow and approve the RepoTunnel authorization request. A normal reconnect should not require deleting your approved project state. Tools look stale Refresh or rescan the RepoTunnel app/actions in the MCP client if RepoTunnel's MCP schema changed. Diagnose each layer separately First establish that RepoTunnel itself is running and has an approved workspace. Next inspect gateway/provider readiness, the exact public HTTPS endpoint, and OAuth authorization. Finally verify MCP tool discovery and a real workspace call. If a public /health endpoint responds but tool discovery fails, inspect OAuth/DCR/PKCE and client configuration rather than assuming a working end-to-end connection. Avoid an unsafe quick fix Never bind the raw MCP gateway to a public interface or disable Host validation to work around a connection problem. Direct HTTPS reverse proxy configuration must adapt forwarded Host headers without weakening the local loopback guard. After upgrading RepoTunnel A client can keep an older cached MCP schema. Refresh or rescan actions after upgrading or switching the connector and then retest with list_workspaces. A missing action does not automatically mean the server failed to start. title: Terminal troubleshooting
description: Understand why RepoTunnel may intentionally refuse AI command execution.
searchText: Troubleshooting Linux If Bubblewrap is missing or unusable, RepoTunnel blocks AI terminal execution rather than falling back to an unrestricted shell. Install/fix Bubblewrap and restart RepoTunnel. Credential access A sandboxed shell not seeing a GitHub token does not mean RepoTunnel's trusted GitHub connection is disconnected. The trusted GitHub broker intentionally keeps credentials out of the AI shell. Distinguish policy denial from a crash An unavailable native sandbox is an intentional fail-closed refusal. RepoTunnel does not run AI commands on the unrestricted host simply because Bubblewrap, Windows AppContainer or the macOS backend cannot be initialized. Read the exact error, inspect configured command policy and compare host-vs-sandbox tool visibility using environment diagnostics. Understand hidden credentials Sandboxed AI terminal sessions intentionally omit many credential files and sensitive environment variables. A trusted RepoTunnel GitHub connection can support allowlisted GitHub operations without giving the AI shell direct access to the credential. Do not work around missing credentials by copying your token into the workspace or exporting it in terminal output. Verification commands vs live terminal Platform status
